name: android-friends-usernames
title: Friends: find people by exact username, relationship state, claim and rename your handle
issue: Android issue #57 (this PR delivers the username part only, so it must say 'Part of #57', not 'Closes'). The backend is MERGED and DEPLOYED (Qamooscheh-Backend PR #46); the contract is the usernames/friends sections of C:/Users/epicn/source/repos/Qamooscheh/src/Qamooscheh.Api/API_SPEC.md (read it first; do not guess shapes). The web reference is being built in parallel (Qamooscheh-Web#85, branch friends-usernames, read-only at E:/Code/Projects/Qamooscheh-Web/Qamooscheh-Web) so match its behaviour and copy where it exists, but implement natively. BUILD: (1) Friends search by exact username: input accepts an optional leading @, trims/lowercases, validates with the backend rules (3-20 chars, lowercase letters/digits/_/.); 0 or 1 result with display name + @handle and relationship state with one action: Add, Pending (disabled; Add is idempotent), Accept (incoming), View (open the friend's profile). Map 409/429/blocked to friendly copy; blocked pairs show no result. Replace the old display-name search. (2) Show the learner's own handle with a copy/share action. (3) One-time dismissible prompt to change the auto-assigned handle (dismissal persisted per user) and a rename control using the rename endpoint, with the once-per-30-days, availability, blocklist and held-old-handle errors mapped to copy. (4) Add to docs/SPEC.md the rule from the issue: permissions that fundamentally change how the app is used (lesson reminders, contacts) get an in-app explainer that asks, explains and nudges before the OS prompt. DO NOT build in this PR (list in deviations as follow-ups): friend-request notifications and the local on/off setting, and contacts matching (the backend has no hashed-matching endpoint yet: that is a backend ask). Gradle: run tasks one at a time (lock contention and low memory); Android CI runs unit tests, Roborazzi verification, lint and assembleDevDebug: add tests and record baselines only for intended visual changes. Read CLAUDE.md, README.md and docs/SPEC.md first.
